Initial release of responsive-agent with a strict two-layer, non-blocking agent design.

- Implements a two-layer architecture: main process (never blocks) and subagent (handles execution of long/remote tasks).
- Main process only handles dialog/dispatch; all blocking, remote, or long operations are delegated to subagents.
- Provides clear spawn, timeout, labeling, and lifecycle management conventions for reliable, responsive operation.
- Detailed decision framework and unified action table guide when to exec vs. spawn for any operation.
- Result writing procedures clarify how and where to save outputs (MEMORY.md, daily logs).
